 Order
This application is filed under Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short, BNSS), seeking pre-arrest bail.
2. The applicant is the sole accused in Crime No.749/2025 of Tirur Police Station, Malappuram District.

The offences alleged are punishable under Sections 342, 376(2)
(f), 376(2)(n), 376AB, 354A(1)(i) and 506 of the Indian Penal Code, Section 75 of the Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015 and Sections 5(l), 5(m) and 5(n) read with Section 6, Sections 9(l), 9(m) and 9(n) read with Section 10, and Section 11(i) read with Section 12 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

sentences.text:
3. The prosecution case, in short, is that the applicant, who is the biological father of the victim girl,
subjected her to forceful sexual intercourse during the period from 20.03.2018 to 01.05.2020 and thereby committed the offences.
I have heard Sri.J.R.Prem Navaz, the learned counsel for the applicant and Sri.K.A.Noushad, the learned Senior Public Prosecutor.
Perused the case diary.
5. It is submitted that the absconding final report has already been filed.
Hence, the application for anticipatory bail is not maintainable.
That apart, the applicant has approached this Court without approaching the Sessions Court.
Accordingly, the bail application is dismissed.

Sd/-
DR. KAUSER EDAPPAGATH, JUDGE APA ..4..
